Strike and Fade.name: Strike and Fade
Strike and Fade.description: The user darts in, strikes and slips back into shadow, smoke or a crowd in the same motion. Deals bludgeoning damage (slashing or piercing damage with a blade), and the opponent loses track of the user: they cannot attack the user on their next action unless a sensing Quirk finds the user. Needs cover, darkness, smoke or a crowd close by. Stamina: demanding.
